_about: Hand verdicts on answerable questions for the Llama 3.1 8B runs in eval/results/.

Each label applies only to the exact answer it was made for (answer_sha1 = first 12 hex chars of sha1 of the stripped answer); if a re-run changes the answer, the label is ignored and the automatic verdict is used.

Every answer the main metric marked NOT correct was re-read against the reference and the gold lecture. All passes were also re-read for the main system, the no-course baseline and both syllabus baselines.
Answers not listed keep the main metric's verdict. 'partial' counts as not correct.
Rule: correct = states the reference's main point(s) and nothing clearly wrong about them; extra detail is fine.

borderline = we gave the answer the benefit of the doubt; the strict reading counts these as not correct. q02 (general 'unfaithful to the source' definition, not the course's 'wrongly summarised') and q29 (only 'truncates the long tail', never 'only the k most likely') are borderline in every system where they occur, as are the syllabus baselines' q03 install methods.
Labelled by the developers, not blind to the system; see docs/report.md, Limitations.
